info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Delinquent Account Management API
info.description: The Delinquent Account Management API enables financial institutions to efficiently manage and update the status of delinquent accounts. This API allows for the modification of account details and status through PATCH operations, facilitating timely interventions and resolutions for consumers facing payment difficulties. Target users include bank operations teams and debt recovery specialists, who utilize this API to improve customer recovery processes and streamline account handling workflows. By leveraging this API, institutions can enhance their customer relationship management while minimizing financial risks.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the handling details of a specific delinquent account identified by the account number. Ensure to provide the necessary data fields in the request body to perform the update successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the operational handling details of a delinquent account identified by the specified account number. It allows modifications to the account's status, notes, and other relevant information as part of the delinquent account management process.
